scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
description: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across the country in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into bank accounts via DBT.
eligible_crops: All
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account; Land Ownership Record (RTC/Pahani); Bank Passbook with IFSC; Active Mobile Number
application_steps: 1. Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or nearest Karnataka Grama One / Raitha Samparka Kendra. 2. Enter Aadhaar number and verify with OTP. 3. Select State: Karnataka, District, Taluk, Village, and enter Land Survey Number / RTC details. 4. Upload land records and submit for Village Nodal Officer / Taluk Tahsildar e-verification.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Department of Agriculture, GoK & Ministry of Agriculture, GoI
description: Comprehensive risk insurance covering yield losses due to non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, pests, unseasonal rains) for notified crops in notified Karnataka areas.
eligible_crops: Paddy; Ragi; Jowar; Maize; Cotton; Groundnut; Tur; Soybean; Sugarcane
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers
required_documents: Pahani (RTC) or Crop Sowing Certificate; Aadhaar Card; Bank Account Details; Crop Declaration / Sowing Certificate
application_steps: 1. Check notified crop for your hobli on Karnataka Samrakshane Portal (samrakshane.karnataka.gov.in). 2. Pay minimal farmer premium (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi) before seasonal cut-off date. 3. Obtain insurance proposal receipt with acknowledgment number. 4. In case of localized calamity, report within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App or helpline 1800-180-1551.
application_period: Kharif: May 15 to July 31 / Rabi: Sept 15 to Dec 15

scheme_name: Karnataka Krishi Bhagya Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: State initiative to secure sustainable farming in dryland and rainfed agro-climatic zones of Karnataka through in-situ rainwater harvesting (Krishi Honda / Farm Ponds), polythene lining, diesel/solar pump sets, and micro-irrigation systems.
eligible_districts: Rainfed dryland areas of Karnataka (North Karnataka and dry belts of South Karnataka)
eligible_crops: All; Ragi; Jowar; Paddy; Maize; Cotton; Groundnut; Tur
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; SC/ST; General
required_documents: Current RTC (Pahani); Aadhaar Card; Caste Certificate (if SC/ST); Bank Passbook Copy; Passport size photograph
application_steps: 1. Apply through Seva Sindhu or K-Kisan online portal or visit Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) office. 2. Submit RTC showing rainfed category and land measurement sketch. 3. Field inspection by agricultural officer for GPS tagging. 4. Post-construction verification and DBT release into beneficiary account.
location_restrictions: Rainfed dryland areas of Karnataka (North Karnataka and dry belts of South Karnataka)

department: Fictional Demonstration Dept (Hackathon Sandbox)

department: Fictional Demonstration Dept (Hackathon Sandbox)
description: NOTICE: Fictional benchmark record generated for testing deterministic equipment qualification filters.

department: Fictional Demonstration Dept (Hackathon Sandbox)
description: NOTICE: Fictional benchmark record created strictly for testing soil amendment recommendations.

scheme_name: Modified Interest Subvention Scheme via Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI / NABARD
description: Provides short-term production credit up to ₹3,00,000 for crop cultivation and post-harvest expenses at 7% p.a., reduced to effectively 4% p.a. on prompt repayment through 3% interest subvention.
eligible_crops: All
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: Filled KCC application form; RTC / Pahani or Cultivation / Lease agreement; Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook with photo
application_steps: 1. Approach nearest Commercial Bank, Grameena Bank, or Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACS). 2. Submit KCC application with RTC/Pahani or tenant cultivation proof. 3. Bank processes and issues RuPay Kisan Credit Card within 14 working days.

scheme_name: Soil Health Card Scheme & Nutrient Management
department: Department of Agriculture, GoK & MoA&FW, GoI
description: Provides customized soil health cards assessing 12 critical chemical and physical parameters (macro-nutrients N, P, K; secondary nutrient S; micro-nutrients Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo; and pH, EC, OC) with dosage recommendations for balanced fertilizer use.
eligible_crops: All
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women; Tenant Farmers
required_documents: Soil Sample with Plot Survey Number; Aadhaar Card; RTC / Pahani copy
application_steps: 1. Collect 'V' shaped composite soil sample before sowing from your plot. 2. Submit soil sample to Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or District Soil Testing Lab. 3. Download printed Soil Health Card online at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
application_period: Pre-sowing (April-May for Kharif, Sept-Oct for Rabi)

scheme_name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation)
department: Department of Agriculture & Horticulture, Government of Karnataka
description: Promotes water-use efficiency through financial assistance for Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems: 55% subsidy for Small & Marginal Farmers, 45% for other farmers, enhanced up to 90% in Karnataka for SC/ST cultivators.
eligible_crops: All; Sugarcane; Cotton; Maize; Arecanut; Banana; Vegetables; Paddy
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: Current RTC / Pahani; Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Water & Electricity Availability Certificate; Caste Certificate (if SC/ST)
application_steps: 1. Register on Karnataka Seva Sindhu or K-Kisan portal. 2. Select empanelled micro-irrigation manufacturer and submit farm sketch. 3. Pre-installation inspection by Assistant Director of Agriculture/Horticulture. 4. Field installation and GPS verification, followed by direct subsidy release.

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Component-B: Standalone Solar Agriculture Pumps
department: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy, GoI / KREDL Karnataka
description: Subsidizes installation of standalone off-grid solar-powered agriculture pumps (3 HP to 7.5 HP). 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% Karnataka KREDL subsidy), with farmer contributing only 40% (or bank loan).
eligible_crops: All
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: RTC (Pahani); Aadhaar Card; Bank Account Details; Borewell / Water Source Certificate; Electricity Board (ESCOM) No-connection certificate
application_steps: 1. Apply online via KREDL solar pump portal (kredlinfo.in). 2. Submit land RTC, water source proof, and ESCOM non-electrification certificate. 3. Pay 40% beneficiary share online upon document verification. 4. Empanelled solar vendor installs pump within 90 days with 5-year comprehensive maintenance.
application_period: Annual Quota Allocation Window (July to December)

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
department: Department of Agriculture, GoK & MoA&FW, GoI
description: Subsidizes farm machinery and implements (tractors, power tillers, rotavators, multi-crop seed drills, weeders, harvesters) with 40%-50% financial assistance, and promotes Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) with up to 40% capital grant.
eligible_crops: All; Paddy; Sugarcane; Cotton; Maize; Ragi
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: RTC (Pahani); Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Caste Certificate (for SC/ST); Dealer Quotation for Machinery
application_steps: 1. Register on Direct Benefit Transfer in Agriculture Mechanization portal (agrimachinery.nic.in). 2. Select equipment, make/model, and authorized dealer in Karnataka. 3. Departmental approval and verification by Taluk Assistant Director of Agriculture. 4. Physical inspection and subsidy crediting via Aadhaar-linked DBT.
application_period: Kharif Season Portal Opening (May to October)

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
description: Medium-to-long term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets (warehouses, cold storage, silos, sorting/grading units, drying yards) with 3% per annum interest subvention up to ₹2 Crore for up to 7 years.
eligible_crops: All
farmer_category: All; General; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR); Land records / Lease deed; KYC & PAN documents; Bank in-principle sanction letter
application_steps: 1. Register on AIF portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in). 2. Upload DPR, project cost estimate, and land title/lease document. 3. Ministry evaluates and sanctions within 60 days, followed by participating bank loan disbursement.

scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
department: Department of Horticulture, Government of Karnataka
description: Comprehensive horticulture development covering new orchard establishment (mango, arecanut, banana, pepper, citrus, pomegranate), rejuvenation of senile plantations, protected cultivation, and post-harvest pack houses with 40%-50% capital subsidy.
eligible_districts: All Karnataka Districts (special focus on Coastal, Malnad and Southern Dry Belts)
eligible_crops: Arecanut; Banana; Pepper; Mango; Vegetables; Flowers; Spices; Pomegranate
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: RTC (Pahani) with horticulture crop entry; Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Soil and Water testing report
application_steps: 1. Apply at Senior Assistant Director of Horticulture (SADH) Taluk office or online via Seva Sindhu. 2. Submit farm location sketch and proposed plantation project details. 3. Field inspection by Horticulture Officer and planting material issuance. 4. Subsidy released directly to bank account upon plantation survival verification.
location_restrictions: All Karnataka Districts (special focus on Coastal, Malnad and Southern Dry Belts)

scheme_name: National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF / BPKP)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI & GoK
description: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 per hectare for 3 years to adopt natural chemical-free farming, setup on-farm bio-input preparation units (Jeevamrutha, Beejamrutha, Ghanajeevamrutha), farmer cluster training, and free PGS-India green certification.
eligible_districts: All Karnataka Districts (Cluster-based selection across Gram Panchayats)
eligible_crops: All; Paddy; Ragi; Jowar; Pulses; Millets; Vegetables; Arecanut; Banana
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: RTC (Pahani); Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Natural Farming Cluster Farmer Declaration
application_steps: 1. Join designated Natural Farming Cluster via Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK). 2. Complete on-field master trainer demonstration on Beejamrutha and Jeevamrutha. 3. Register on PGS-India portal for organic traceability. 4. Incentive credited via DBT in annual phases upon cluster peer review.
location_restrictions: All Karnataka Districts (Cluster-based selection across Gram Panchayats)

scheme_name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) Electronic Trading Platform
department: Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC) & Karnataka APMC
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal integrating 1,361 mandis across 23 states. Provides online transparent bidding, quality assaying laboratories, electronic weighing, online payments directly into farmers' bank accounts without commission deduction.
eligible_crops: All; Paddy; Ragi; Jowar; Maize; Cotton; Groundnut; Tur; Arecanut
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook with IFSC; APMC Gate Entry Pass / Sowing Record
application_steps: 1. Bring farm produce to e-NAM integrated APMC market yard gate. 2. Generate e-Gate Pass and submit sample for electronic assaying assay. 3. Live bidding takes place online across national buyers. 4. Farmer accepts winning bid, weighing completed, and payment transferred via DBT.
application_period: Open Throughout Year on Mandi Trading Days

scheme_name: National Food Security Mission: Certified Seed Distribution & Mini-kits
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Subsidizes high-yielding and climate-resilient certified seeds of pulses (tur, gram, moong, urad) and coarse cereals (ragi, jowar, bajra, maize) with 50% subsidy on seed cost and free pulse seed mini-kits for small and marginal farmers.
eligible_crops: Tur; Ragi; Jowar; Maize; Groundnut; Paddy; Pulses; Soybean
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; SC/ST; Women; General; Tenant Farmers
required_documents: RTC (Pahani) or Tenant Sowing Certificate; Aadhaar Card; Farmer ID (FID / Fruits ID)
application_steps: 1. Visit nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) during pre-sowing window. 2. Provide FID (FRUITS ID) or Aadhaar number for biometric POS authentication. 3. Collect subsidized certified seed bags with official cash receipt.

scheme_name: Formation & Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
department: NABARD / SFAC / NCDC & GoK
description: Promotes farmer collectives into registered FPOs to achieve economies of scale. Provides equity grant up to ₹15 Lakh per FPO matching farmer member contribution, management support of ₹18 Lakh for 3 years, and Credit Guarantee up to ₹2 Crore.
eligible_crops: All
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers; Women; General; SC/ST
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; RTC / Land record; FPO Shareholder Membership Form; Bank Account Details
application_steps: 1. Enroll as member shareholder in local Taluk FPO through Raitha Samparka Kendra or CBBO. 2. Contribute one-time nominal share capital (₹1,000 - ₹2,000). 3. Access institutional inputs, rental machinery, and collective aggregation facilities.

scheme_name: Karnataka Raitha Siri Scheme for Millets Promotion
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Special state financial incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare (up to a maximum of 2 hectares = ₹20,000) directly transferred into farmers' bank accounts via DBT for cultivating designated millets (Ragi, Jowar, Bajra, Foxtail millet, Little millet, Kodo millet).
eligible_districts: All Karnataka Districts (rainfed millet zones in North & South Karnataka)
eligible_crops: Ragi; Jowar; Millets; Bajra
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: Current RTC (Pahani) with Millet Crop Survey Entry; Aadhaar Card; FRUITS ID (FID); Bank Passbook
application_steps: 1. Ensure millet crop is officially recorded in Digital Crop Survey (Bele Samikshe) during Kharif season. 2. Register application at nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra or via K-Kisan / Fruits portal. 3. Village Nodal Officer verifies crop standing. 4. Incentive credited via DBT into Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
location_restrictions: All Karnataka Districts (rainfed millet zones in North & South Karnataka)
application_period: Kharif Season (Crop survey entry July to October)

scheme_name: Karnataka Farm Mechanization Assistance Scheme (Raita Shakti / Agri-Mech)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: State scheme providing 50% to 90% capital subsidy for purchase of small farm machineries (power weeders, paddy transplanters, knapsack/power sprayers, chaff cutters, seed-cum-fertilizer drills, diesel engines) with preferential funding for SC/ST and women farmers.
eligible_crops: All; Paddy; Sugarcane; Arecanut; Maize; Cotton
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; SC/ST; Women; General
required_documents: RTC (Pahani); Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Caste Certificate (if SC/ST); FRUITS ID
application_steps: 1. Apply via Karnataka Seva Sindhu or K-Kisan portal. 2. Submit quotation from authorized agricultural machinery dealer. 3. Verification and allotment order by Taluk Assistant Director of Agriculture. 4. Machine delivered and verified via GPS photo, subsidy released to dealer/farmer.

scheme_name: Karnataka Micro-Irrigation Promotion Scheme (Top-Up)
department: Department of Agriculture & Horticulture, Government of Karnataka
description: State top-up scheme enhancing central PMKSY micro-irrigation subsidies to 90% for SC/ST farmers and 75% for General category farmers (up to 5 acres) for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation units.
eligible_crops: All; Sugarcane; Arecanut; Banana; Vegetables; Paddy; Cotton; Maize
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; SC/ST; General; Women
required_documents: Current RTC (Pahani); Aadhaar Card; Electricity / Water source bill or certificate; Bank Passbook; Caste Certificate
application_steps: 1. Submit online application on Karnataka Seva Sindhu / K-Kisan. 2. Empanelled vendor surveys the field and prepares technical layout. 3. Department approves subsidy sanction. 4. Vendor installs system, GPS-tagged inspection conducted, subsidy released.

scheme_name: Karnataka Polyhouse & Protected Horticulture Cultivation Scheme
department: Department of Horticulture, Government of Karnataka
description: Provides 50% capital subsidy for construction of naturally ventilated polyhouses and shade net structures (up to 4,000 sq.m) for high-value off-season vegetable, flower, and exotic crop cultivation.
eligible_districts: All Karnataka Districts (peri-urban and high-value zones)
eligible_crops: Vegetables; Flowers; Capsicum; Tomato; Cucumber; Banana; Orchids
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: RTC (Pahani); Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Water Quality Test Report; Polyhouse Technical Drawing
application_steps: 1. Apply at District Senior Assistant Director of Horticulture (SADH) office or Seva Sindhu. 2. Submit quotation and structural drawings from authorized fabrication agency. 3. Department issues administrative sanction. 4. Post-construction inspection and subsidy credit via DBT.
location_restrictions: All Karnataka Districts (peri-urban and high-value zones)

scheme_name: Karnataka Savayava Bhagya & Organic Village Mission
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: Promotes chemical-free organic farming in designated village clusters of 100 hectares. Provides assistance for vermicompost pits, bio-digesters, organic bio-fertilizer kits, and third-party certified organic export facilitation with ₹10,000/ha state support.
eligible_crops: All; Paddy; Ragi; Jowar; Pulses; Sugarcane; Arecanut; Banana; Pepper
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: RTC (Pahani); Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Organic Farming Agreement
application_steps: 1. Register with Taluk Organic Farming Federation / Raitha Samparka Kendra. 2. Join local village organic farmer group. 3. Setup vermicompost pit and use approved bio-fertilizers. 4. Incentive credited via DBT upon third-party organic inspection.

scheme_name: Karnataka Parihara: SDRF / NDRF Calamity Crop Loss Relief
department: Revenue & Agriculture Department, Government of Karnataka
description: Direct financial relief for farmers experiencing crop loss of 33% or more due to natural disasters (floods, heavy rain, drought, hailstorms). Compensation rates: ₹8,500/ha for rainfed crops, ₹17,000/ha for irrigated crops, and ₹22,500/ha for perennial/horticultural crops.
eligible_crops: All; Paddy; Arecanut; Banana; Pepper; Sugarcane; Cotton; Maize; Ragi; Jowar
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: Current RTC (Pahani) or Joint Cultivation Certificate; Aadhaar Card; Bank Account Details; Joint Damage Survey Report (Parihara ID)
application_steps: 1. Village Accountant (VA) and Agriculture Officer conduct joint GPS damage survey. 2. Survey details and photo uploaded to Karnataka Parihara Portal (parihara.karnataka.gov.in). 3. Farmer verifies survey entry using Aadhaar number on Parihara portal. 4. Funds disbursed automatically through Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB).
application_period: Post-calamity notification window (active within 30 days of disaster)

scheme_name: Karnataka Pashu Bhagya Scheme for Integrated Animal Husbandry
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, GoK
description: Subsidizes establishment of small dairy units (2 cows/buffaloes), sheep/goat rearing (10+1), poultry, or piggery units with 50% subsidy for General farmers and 70% subsidy for SC/ST farmers, with short-term livestock credit up to ₹1.2 Lakh at zero/low interest.
eligible_crops: All; Fodder
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: RTC (Pahani) or Resident Certificate; Aadhaar Card; Bank Passbook; Caste Certificate (if SC/ST); Veterinary Officer Health Certificate
application_steps: 1. Apply via Taluk Assistant Director of Veterinary Services or Seva Sindhu. 2. Verification of fodder availability and shed location by local Veterinary Officer. 3. Animal purchase through official cattle purchase committee (Shandy). 4. Subsidy directly credited into beneficiary bank account.

scheme_name: Karnataka Chief Minister Raitha Siri / CM-Kisan Top-Up Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
description: State supplemental top-up scheme providing additional annual financial assistance to PM-KISAN eligible landholding farmers in Karnataka. NOTE: State budgetary allocation and disbursement schedule for the current financial cycle is currently under official cabinet review.
eligible_crops: All
farmer_category: Small and Marginal; General; SC/ST; Women
required_documents: Aadhaar Card; RTC (Pahani); PM-KISAN Registration ID; Bank Passbook
application_steps: 1. Active registration in PM-KISAN portal. 2. Automatic linkage through Karnataka FRUITS database. 3. Awaiting formal notification of current disbursement cycle.

scheme_name: Karnataka Punyakoti Dattu & Cattle Insurance Subsidy Scheme
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, GoK
description: Subsidizes indigenous cattle adoption and provides premium subsidies for rural cattle insurance. NOTE: Gram Panchayat quota allocation and taluk-level beneficiary targets are currently undergoing quarterly verification with local veterinary offices.
eligible_districts: All Karnataka Districts (Quota subject to local Gram Panchayat)
eligible_crops: All; Fodder
farmer_category: All; Small and Marginal; Tenant Farmers; General; SC/ST
required_documents: INAPH Ear Tag Number; Aadhaar Card; Veterinary Certificate; Bank Passbook
application_steps: 1. Contact local Gram Panchayat Veterinary Dispensary. 2. Submit cattle ear-tag number and health record. 3. Verification against current quarter taluk quota.
location_restrictions: All Karnataka Districts (Quota subject to local Gram Panchayat)
